batting.name: MEK Hussey
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b L Balaji

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b YK Pathan

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c S Randiv b R Ashwin

balls.text: full ball outside off stump, Badri steers the ball through cover point and tries to come back for the second run, the throw from the deep is good and Boucher breaks the stumps and beats Badri's dive. He sacrificed his wicket there, Badri's played a superb innings.
full toss and Morkel hits it flat and straight towards the fielder on the long-off boundary
Morkel tries to clear the ground but ends up mis-hitting it in the air over extra cover
Badri had come forward and so was not in a good position to play the full toss angling into the body, pushed towards cover for one
the yorker around off stump, Morkel just plays on the off side and runs
connects with the bottom of the bat and gets a single down the ground
Badri lifts a good length ball towards long off, reaches the fielder on the bounce
Kallis is back to bowling full and wide outside off, Morkel plays towards point
that's too straight from Kallis and Morkel finally cashes in, smashing the ball to the long-off boundary
full ball outside off again, Morkel drives powerfully through cover and Bhatia runs to his left and saves the boundary. Chennai finally reach 100
Morkel swings hard at a length ball outside off but can't make contact
Badri mis-times the hit down the ground but gets to 50. Top innings, on a pitch where his team-mates have struggled to strike at a run a ball, Badri is striking at 135
Badri moves outside off stump and nudges the ball behind square
Morkel jams down on the ball and plays towards point, Lee is keeping it full and wide outside off so Morkel can't launch over midwicket and long-on
another full ball outside off, Morkel tries to reach for it from his crease but gets beaten
full ball wide outside off, Morkel swings hard and away from his body and misses, Boucher celebrates after catching the ball but Lee didn't appeal much, there was a noise as the ball passed bat
Badri tries to move outside off and paddle the ball past short fine leg, he misses and gets hit on the back leg
a low full toss outside off from round the wicket, Morkel drives to the fielder on the cover boundary
that's a rubbish long hop, and not a slow one this time, Badri waits in his crease and pulls, launching the ball over the deep midwicket boundary
the slower short ball, Badri pulls hard to the fielder on the deep midwicket boundary
full ball outside off, driven to deep cover
in the blockhole outside off stump, not allowing Morkel the space he needs to hit over his favourite cow corner region, Morkel tries to steer through point but gets beaten
that's far too wide outside off, Morkel doesn't even try reaching for it
short ball and Badri stays in his crease to pull, hitting the ball flat and on the first bounce to Kallis at deep square
Badri makes room and drives a length ball to Unadkat at wide third man
Badri makes room and tries to hit down the ground, he gets a thick outside edge which sends the ball over cover
driven to long off for one
played towards the fielder at cover

Morkel tries to heave on the leg side but misses, the ball hits his pad and goes on the leg side, Badri sets off for an impossible single, Boucher gets to the ball quickly, Morkel isn't moving, Badri turns around and tries to make his ground, Boucher's throw is poor
Badri makes room and drives the ball fluently towards long off
played towards midwicket

caught at deep midwicket, and then dropped! And Lee looks like he's hurt himself. Morkel heaved the length ball high over midwicket, Lee came charging in from the boundary and slid as he reached it, he then tumbled over once and lost grip on the ball, I think. A top effort, but has to go down as a drop. Not many fielders would have even got to that catch. The ball actually popped out as it hit his hand and then he tried to grab the second chance, and failed.
slower ball outside off, Morkel steers off the back foot towards point
the slower ball outside off, played from the crease behind point
driven from the crease towards cover
and again, short of a length ball with width on offer, Morkel smashes it through extra cover
Morkel hammers the length ball straight towards the bowler, Unadkat got a bit of hand to it as he tried to avoid the ball and it raced to the straight boundary
too short from Yusuf, Badri moves his front foot to creating hitting space and swings hard, lofting the ball wide of the fielder on the long-on boundary, one-bounce four
played through point once again by Morkel
dropped, but a tough chance. Badri charged and swung the ball hard and flat towards midwicket where Unadkat dived to his left and got one hand to it, he couldn't hold on
played with an open face to guide the ball through point
defended towards silly point, where Gambhir fields
pushed off the front foot towards cover
the slower short ball way outside off, Badri aims to heave through the leg side and is beaten
length delivery outside off, Morkel drives off the back foot through cover point
very short ball at 117kph, Badri pulls hard along the round to the fielder in the deep
a zippy ball out of no where, Badri tried to cut it fine but missed
short ball but it's so slow off the pitch, Morkel jumps back and swats it through square leg, gentle stroke
short of a length outside off, Badri chips it towards third man, ball reaches the fielder on the first bounce
Morkel leans forward to smother a well-flighted delivery
tossed up far too wide outside off
plays the ball from the crease towards midwicket where Morgan slides to his right and cuts it off
tossed up slow and straight, Badri nudges towards short midwicket and sends Abdulla on a chase
cut off the back foot to point
terrific shot, Badri makes room and opens the face to steer the ball from his stumps behind point and to the third man boundary
played off the back foot towards cover, Badri was trying to make room but stopped as the ball spun away from him

that's an ordinary ball but he's got a wicket! Balaji banged it in short, Hussey saw a scoring opportunity and pulled it, he hit it flat and straight to Morgan at midwicket, picked out the fielder. He perhaps tried to hit it a bit too hard, looking for a release after all the pressure
Badrinath uses the length and width outside off and steers towards third man
played off the back foot behind point
that's very slow outside leg stump, Hussey begins to pull and is very early on the shot, he ends up swatting it awkwardly behind square and sloppy backing up allows the overthrow
short ball and Badrinath swivels and pulls to deep square leg, enjoying the extra pace is Badri
Badrinath steps out and makes room by moving towards leg to steer the length ball wide of the fielder on the third man boundary, top shot
driven along the ground to long-on

and there it is!! Badrinath makes room and lofts the ball towards long-on, the fielder on the boundary lost sight of the ball, it was hit low and flat and flew over his head. Jaidev Unadkat was the fielder. Yusuf stands with hands on hips. He thinks it should have been caught
played towards square leg off the back foot
defended from the crease, Hussey doesn't know where the ball has gone
Badrinath charges and swings hard, hitting the ball along the ground towards deep midwicket, there's a fielder on the boundary
Hussey gets down low and paddles the ball off his stumps towards fine leg
driven off the front foot towards long off
this time he makes room and drives through cover
Badrinath makes room to hit a straight ball on the off side, it was slow and straight and Badrinath had to dig it out of the blockhole
played off the back foot on the leg side
Badrinath stays in his crease and nudges the ball off his body towards fine leg
fuller length on leg and middle, Hussey moves forward and clips it towards long-on
short of a length and Hussey drives the ball off the back foot towards long off, still no boundary in the innings. This has to be a first.
driven through cover for a single
Badrinath makes room by moving towards leg and punches the ball towards Yusuf's right, the bowler moves quickly and fields
tossed up on middle and leg, Badrinath works the ball through square
played off the back foot through square
the ball grips the pitch outside off and spins away from Hussey's prod, beating the bat
the batsman moves across and paddles the ball towards fine leg
played from the crease towards midwicket
Hussey goes on the back foot and forces the length ball through midwicket
absolutely no pace on the ball, off stump line, Badri pushes towards cover point and runs immediately
length delivery on leg and middle, played off the back foot towards midwicket
straight delivery on a good length, played back to the bowler
played back towards the bowler
played off the front foot towards midwicket

caught at midwicket! Yusuf took all the pace off the ball and angled it into Raina, he came forward and tried to swing it over midwicket, didn't make proper contact and hit it straight to Kallis. Yusuf celebrates aggressively.
Hussey goes back and nudges the ball with sift hands on the off
pushed off the back foot towards mid-off, also in the air for a while
Raina punches off the back foot and it nearly carries to the bowler
starts with one that drifts down leg side
a low full toss outside off, Raina stays in his crease, gets low and steers the ball towards third man, a little wider and that would have been four
Lee fires in the yorker from round the wicket at 144kph, Raina lifts his back foot out of the way and digs it out
full ball angling into leg stump, Hussey tries to flick from his crease and misses
short of a length angling into the left-hander, Raina stays in his crease and nudges towards midwicket, these two batsman are so quick between wickets
Lee goes round the wicket and bowls a length ball outside off, Raina reaches for it and plays it towards the bowler
pitched on leg stump, played towards midwicket
Raina nudges his first ball off the pads towards midwicket and sets off

caught and bowled! Vijay steps out a fraction and is beaten in the flight, he stops and plays a soft flicky kind of shot and ends up chipping it back to the bowler at a gentle pace and lovely height. That's the easiest caught and bowled in the world
terrific wicket to wicket line, Vijay simply blocks with a straight bat
pushed off the back foot in the air but short of the bowler
Hussey steps out again and tries to play on the leg side, he doesn't make contact and is hit on the pad. That ball was flighted well and dipped on the batsman
Hussey steps down the pitch and plays the ball towards midwicket
short and wide outside off, that was there to be hit and Vijay did, slapping it from the crease, he can't find the gap at cover though
played off the back foot towards point, again there's no way past the fielder
another slower ball outside off stump, driven off the front foot to cover
the yorker isn't quite right and Vijay flicks the full ball off his toes towards deep backward square
the slower ball and the length is fuller, Vijay was on the front foot too early and had to wait before defending on the off side
length ball on off stump, cut off the back foot to cover point, the field is packed on the off side
loud shout of "No" as Balaji reaches the ball quickly at square leg, Hussey played that off the back foot
played from the crease towards midwicket
drifts on to middle and leg, Vijay leans forward and clips it off his pas through square
Vijay strides forward and defends towards point
played off the pads between midwicket and mid-on, Vijay is away and Hussey urged him back for the second
Hussey moves back into his crease and pushes the ball off his pads through square
Lee finishes an excellent over with another tight delivery just outside off, Vijay shoulders arms
good length outside off, Vijay stays in his crease and drives towards extra cover
Hussey wants the quick single after pushing the ball gently towards mid-off on the back foot, he dives to make his ground
short ball and Hussey pulls crisply, but can't beat the in-field at midwicket
good length once again, closer to off stump this time, Hussey lifts his bat out of the way
good length outside off stump from over the wicket, Hussey lets it go through the the keeper
Kallis drives from the crease towards long-on
Towary moves forward and across to nudge the ball towards leg for a single
drifts down leg side this time
Tiwary moves forward and plays the ball extremely fine past the keeper to the third man boundary, he opened the face very late
played towards short third man
played off the pads towards short fine leg
pushed towards long-on for a single
a full toss on middle and leg, Tiwary gets down low and sweeps towards long leg
Tiwary tries to play a very late cut and misses
played gently off the front foot towards cover
shot! Kallis makes a bit of room and smashes the cover drive into the gap on the boundary
paddled round the corner towards short fine leg
driven towards long off but Raina cuts it off by diving from extra cover
nudged off the pads towards short fine leg,
finally short third man stops a single, the ball was played straight to him
Tiwary nudges towards short third man and runs, Dhoni needs a quicker fielder there
Kallis moves back and across, dabs towards the off side, and sets off for a rather quick single
played from the crease towards deep point
dabbed from the crease towards short third man
punched off the back foot towards cover point
pushed off the front foot towards cover
Tiwary moves inside the line, gets down low, and paddles the ball past the fielder at short fine leg, Jakati had strayed down leg side
Kallis drives the ball towards long on
played back towards the bowler
Tiwary gets off the mark by playing the ball towards square leg

caught! Gambhir charges and looks to hit the ball down the ground once again, he slices it and sends the ball swirling towards cover. Randiv runs to his left from the point region and dives to hold a superb catch on the edge of the circle. Gambhir actually connected with the bottom of the bat and it turned in his hand
cut off the back foot towards point once again
cut off the back foot into the ground toward the off side
pushed off the front foot towards cover
Gambhir charges and lofts the ball high over mid-off, Morkel pursues, dives on the boundary and just saves it
Gambhir moves back and towards leg to one that angles into him and cuts the ball from in front of the stumps towards point
Gambhir walks forward and towards the off to create the angle needed to glance the ball off his pads towards fine leg
Gambhir jumps on the back foot and defends on the leg side
Kallis plays towards square leg and runs, Morkel hits the stumps at the bowler's end but Kallis is safe
shot! Bollinger bowls a length ball outside off, Kallis uses the angle across him and drives, placing it wide of mid-off
short of a length ball and Kallis mis-hits the pull towards mid-on
played off the back foot towards point, Bollinger's angling the ball across the right-hander
played from the stumps off the back foot towards backward point
shorter ball and Gambhir cuts but can't beat the in-field at point
superb offbreak, Ashwin drifts the ball into the left-hander from round the wicket and spins past the outside edge of Gambhir's forward push
Kallis opens the face to play the ball between point and short third man
nudged off the front foot through midwicket
Gambhir tries to hit down the ground but mis-hits in the air over the bowler's head, the ball barely makes it past the circle
Kallis makes room and plays towards cover
Kallis makes room a bit by moving towards leg - he came forward as well - and then heaves the ball high over the leg side, the ball falls safely at wide long-on
Kallis drives off the back foot but can't find the gap, there are five fielders in the circle on the off side
Gambhir's very lucky! He tries to close the face to a good length ball and gets a leading edge that lobs safely over the bowler, it could have gone anywhere, he then ran a risky single
that's a poor ball down leg side and Gambhir glances the ball with ease to the fine leg boundary
short of a length outside off, Gambhir cuts from his crease and Hussey fields at point, so many fielders in the point region - three
played towards the bowler's right, Ashwin moves across the pitch and fields
gets a leading edge towards the bowler
punched through extra cover again, mid-off has to run to his right
Gambhir charges, moves toward leg to make room, and launches the ball inside out over extra cover, top shot on a tough pitch
Ashwin slants one into Gambhir and hits the pad
bowled him! Ashwin pitched the offbreak outside off and spun it away a little, Morgan went back to cut, the ball kept a little low, bounced once off the bottom edge and then went on to the stumps
the first one slides down leg side from round the wicket, Morgan tries to glance but it's too far away
pitches outside leg this time, a slower ball again, Morgan nudges on the on-side for one
Morgan steps out, Morkel bowls a slower ball but it's down leg side
cut hard once again, too much width, but this time Morgan can't pierce the in-field
just a little width outside off, Morgan moves back in a flash and cuts the ball hard through a packed off side field, Kolkata have hit a boundary off the fourth ball, Chennai did it after nine overs
length ball outside off, Kallis strides forward and drives towards mid-off
Morgan moves forward and towards the off to work the ball on the leg side, he gets hit on the thigh and runs a leg bye, Morkel appealed for lbw but too high
good length ball on leg and middle, Morgan plays off his pads towards midwicket
